name: Kaga (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kaga city emblem in purple, green and yellow: a purple stylised swoosh enclosing a green ring with a yellow disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kaga, a city in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 July 2005.

features.role: Kaga city emblem — a purple stylised swoosh enclosing a green ring with a yellow disc
